author: Bestrade Pharma Company, El Obour, Cairo
_comment_baseUrl: The domain. Printed QR codes point at <baseUrl>/p/<code>/, so this can never change once boxes are printed.
_comment_defaultLang: Language a product page opens in when the reader has not picked one. Company pages are English at / and Arabic at /ar/.
_comment_contactFormEndpoint: Formspree (or similar) form URL, e.g. https://formspree.io/f/xxxxxxx. While empty, the contact page shows a WhatsApp button instead of the form.
_comment_gtmId: Google Tag Manager container id, e.g. GTM-ABC1234. While empty, no tracking code is added.
